cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e \
  && echo '=== tools/perf structure ===' \
  && find tools/perf -type f | head -20 \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== tools/perf/src/main.rs (first 80 lines) ===' \
  && head -80 tools/perf/src/main.rs \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== profile-core structure ===' \
  && find packages/profile-core -type f -name '*.rs' | head -10 \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== profile-core/src/lib.rs (first 30 lines) ===' \
  && head -30 packages/profile-core/src/lib.rs 2>/dev/null || echo 'NO FILE' \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== profile-core Cargo.toml ===' \
  && cat packages/profile-core/Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null || echo 'NO FILE'
